title: Artifact
description: The metadata record for a stored blob. This is the *only* thing named Artifact in METIS. It never carries the bytes: ADR-007 gives the store `get(id) -> {bytes, metadata}` and `head(id) -> metadata` precisely so the metadata can be listed, referenced and returned from the API without moving payloads. A thing a plan intends to produce but has not produced yet is an `ArtifactExpectation` and lives in Plan.schema.json — it cannot be an Artifact because it has no bytes to checksum.

uri.description: Where the bytes live. Any scheme — s3://, file://, https://.

checksum.description: Content hash of the payload. ADR-001 requires every artifact to carry one; pinning the algorithm prefix means a checksum can actually be verified rather than merely stored.

metadata.description: Free-form, artifact-kind-specific detail. Nothing in the core reads this.

provenance.description: Typed links back to what this came from (ADR-001). An untyped blob here would make the provenance rules unimplementable, so the shape is fixed even though the relation vocabulary stays open.

rel.description: Known values: derives_from, produced_by, justified_by, in_project.

ref.description: An Identifier of another METIS entity, or an external URI.
